description: PHP unit test class 'ReportGeneratorServiceTest' that tests various functionalities of the 'ReportGeneratorService' class, including report identification, header definition retrieval, and report data normalization for PIM reports.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of 'ReportGeneratorService'.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of ReportGeneratorService, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testIsPimReport
methods.description: Tests the 'isPimReport' method to verify correct identification of PIM reports by report ID.

methods.name: testGetHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Verifies that header definitions are correctly retrieved and formatted for a specific report ID.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Checks that report data is correctly normalized and count is accurate for a given report ID.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportDataForPastEmployees
methods.description: Verifies normalized data and count for past employee reports.
